title: Health check endpoint reports the service is up
steps: 1. Send GET /ping
expected_result: HTTP 201 with body 'Created'

title: Valid credentials return an auth token
steps: 1. Send POST /auth with valid username and password
expected_result: HTTP 200 and a 15 character token

title: Login is rejected for invalid credential combinations
steps: 1. Send POST /auth with each invalid combination (wrong password, unknown user, wrong case, empty values)
expected_result: HTTP 200 with reason 'Bad credentials' and no token

title: Login with an empty body is rejected
steps: 1. Send POST /auth with {}
expected_result: HTTP 200 with reason 'Bad credentials'

title: Create a booking with a valid payload and verify it is persisted
steps: 1. Send POST /booking with a valid payload 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: Created booking echoes the payload and GET returns identical data

title: Create bookings across valid data variations
steps: 1. For each row in booking-variations.json send POST /booking
expected_result: HTTP 200 and stored booking equals the payload for every variation

title: Booking is rejected when a mandatory field is missing
steps: 1. Remove one mandatory field (firstname, lastname, totalprice, depositpaid, bookingdates) 2. Send POST /booking
expected_result: HTTP 500 for every missing field

title: Optional field additionalneeds can be omitted
steps: 1. Send POST /booking without additionalneeds
expected_result: HTTP 200 and booking stored without additionalneeds

title: Unsupported Accept header is rejected
steps: 1. Send POST /booking with Accept: text/plain
expected_result: HTTP 418

title: List all bookings returns an array of booking ids
steps: 1. Send GET /booking
expected_result: HTTP 200 with a non-empty array of {bookingid: number}

title: Get a booking by id returns the full booking
steps: 1. Create a booking 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 200 and body matches the booking schema and created data

title: Filter bookings by guest first and last name
preconditions: A booking with a unique guest name exists
steps: 1. Send GET /booking?firstname={f}&lastname={l}
expected_result: Only the matching booking id is returned

title: Unknown booking id returns 404
steps: 1. Send GET /booking/{id} for a non-existent, non-numeric and zero id
expected_result: HTTP 404 'Not Found'

title: Full update with a token replaces every field
preconditions: A booking exists and a valid token
steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/{id} with token cookie and a new payload 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 200 and all fields replaced

title: Partial update changes only the patched fields
preconditions: A booking exists and a valid token
steps: 1. Send PATCH /booking/{id} with firstname and totalprice
expected_result: Only the patched fields change

title: Full update with Basic auth instead of a token
steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/{id} with an Authorization: Basic header
expected_result: HTTP 200 and all fields replaced

title: Update without credentials is forbidden
steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/{id} without token or Basic auth 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 403 and the booking is unchanged

title: Update with an invalid token is forbidden
steps: 1. Send PATCH /booking/{id} with each invalid token
expected_result: HTTP 403 for every invalid token

title: Full update with an incomplete body is rejected
preconditions: A booking exists and a valid token
steps: 1. Send PUT /booking/{id} with only firstname
expected_result: HTTP 400 'Bad Request'

title: Delete a booking and confirm it no longer exists
preconditions: A booking exists and a valid token
steps: 1. Send DELETE /booking/{id} with token 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 201 then HTTP 404

title: Delete without credentials is forbidden and keeps the booking
steps: 1. Send DELETE /booking/{id} without auth 2. Send GET /booking/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 403 and the booking still exists unchanged

title: Deleting a booking that does not exist returns 405
steps: 1. Send DELETE /booking/999999999 with token
expected_result: HTTP 405

title: Filter bookings by check-in and check-out date
preconditions: Bookings exist in the date range
steps: 1. Send GET /booking?checkin={d1}&checkout={d2}
expected_result: Only bookings inside the range are returned

title: Guest books searches amends and cancels a stay
steps: 1. Auth 2. Create 3. Search by name 4. PUT amend 5. PATCH 6. DELETE 7. GET
expected_result: Every step succeeds and the booking is gone at the end

title: Expired token is rejected for updates
preconditions: A token older than its expiry window
steps: 1. Wait for token expiry 2. Send PUT /booking/{id} with the expired token
expected_result: HTTP 403

title: GET /booking p95 latency under 50 concurrent users
steps: 1. Run 50 VUs against GET /booking for 5 minutes
expected_result: p95 latency under 800 ms and error rate under 1%

title: List users returns all 10 users matching the user schema
steps: 1. Send GET /users
expected_result: HTTP 200 with 10 users that match the schema and ids 1-10

title: Get user by id
steps: 1. For each id in user-ids.csv send GET /users/{id}
expected_result: HTTP 200 with the expected username

title: Unknown user id returns 404
steps: 1. Send GET /users/9999
expected_result: HTTP 404 with an empty JSON body

title: Filter users by username
steps: 1. Send GET /users?username=Bret
expected_result: Exactly one matching user is returned

title: Every post returned for a user belongs to that user
steps: 1. For users 1, 4 and 10 send GET /posts?userId={id}
expected_result: 10 posts each with the requested userId

title: Create a post
steps: 1. Send POST /posts with title, body and userId
expected_result: HTTP 201 with the payload and a new id

title: Replace a post with PUT
steps: 1. Send PUT /posts/1 with a full payload
expected_result: HTTP 200 echoing the payload

title: Patch only the title of a post
steps: 1. Send GET /posts/1 2. Send PATCH /posts/1 with a new title
expected_result: Only the title changes

title: Delete a post
steps: 1. Send DELETE /posts/1
expected_result: HTTP 200 with an empty JSON body

title: Comments of a post match the comment schema
steps: 1. Send GET /posts/1/comments
expected_result: Non-empty list of comments that match the schema and reference post 1
